title: Backend runtime config (backend-runtime-v1)
description: Shape of BACKEND_HOME/config.yaml (and artifact config/defaults.yaml). Hermes-Lanyard is the v1 reference: Portal settings and deploy templates consume this surface. Secrets must not be committed in examples or defaults; use host env (.env), secret managers, or key_env / ${VAR} references. Root additionalProperties is true so full Hermes-Lanyard configs validate while the contract documents the settings surface used by Portal (models, providers, skills, cron).

_config_version.description: Optional Hermes config file format version (migrated on load). Platform contract major is independent (this schema's document version is fixed by $id path backend-runtime-v1).

model.description: Active chat model. Hermes accepts a bare model id string or an object. Canonical object key for the model id is `default` (aliases `model` / `name` are accepted by Hermes and normalized on load).

oneOf.description: Bare model id (e.g. anthropic/claude-opus-4.6 or grok-4.5).

providers.description: Named provider overrides and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Keys are provider ids (built-in names or custom). Prefer key_env / ${ENV} for credentials — do not commit plaintext api_key values.

fallback_providers.description: Ordered fallback chain when the primary model/provider fails. Hermes accepts a list of provider/model pairs or legacy single-object shapes.

fallback_model.description: Legacy single fallback (dict or list). Prefer fallback_providers for new configs.

provider_routing.description: OpenRouter-only routing preferences (sort, only, ignore, order, etc.).

skills.description: Skills loading and safety settings. On-disk skill packages live under BACKEND_HOME/skills/ (see filesystem-layout.md); this object configures behavior, not the package tree itself.

cron.description: Cron scheduler settings. Job definitions live in BACKEND_HOME/cron/jobs.json; this object configures the in-process/managed scheduler (provider, Chronos, delivery, retention).

curator.description: Background skill maintenance (stale/archive/consolidate). Related to skills; optional.

agent.description: Agent loop settings (max_turns, timeouts, reasoning_effort, coding posture, etc.).

terminal.description: Terminal tool backend (local, ssh, docker, …). Never commit sudo_password; use host secrets.

platform_toolsets.description: Per-platform toolset presets or lists (cli, telegram, discord, …).

toolsets.description: Legacy global toolsets list (Hermes prefers platform_toolsets).

mcp_servers.description: MCP server definitions. Do not commit env maps or headers that hold tokens; use key refs or host env.

auxiliary.description: Side-task model routing (vision, compression, web_extract, etc.).

memory.description: Persistent MEMORY.md / USER.md limits and nudges.

streaming.description: Gateway progressive-edit streaming to messaging platforms.

gateway.description: Gateway-level options (platforms may also be top-level Hermes keys).

security.description: Optional security scanners and related knobs.

max_concurrent_sessions.description: Cap on concurrent chat sessions; null/0 = unbounded.

model.description: Alias for default (normalized to default on Hermes load).

name.description: Alias for default (normalized to default on Hermes load).

provider.description: Inference provider id (auto, openrouter, anthropic, custom, lmstudio, …).

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL when using custom/local endpoints.

api_base.description: Alias for base_url (normalized on Hermes load).

context_length.description: Total context window override when auto-detect is wrong.

auth_mode.description: Provider auth mode (e.g. entra_id for Azure Foundry).

default_headers.description: Extra HTTP headers for OpenAI-wire requests. Values may be secret — prefer env substitution; omit from committed examples.

extra_headers.description: Alias/merge partner of default_headers; treat values as secrets.

api_key.description: SECRET. Prefer host .env or provider key_env. Must not appear in committed examples or artifact defaults.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL (also accepted as url / api).

key_env.description: Name of environment variable holding the API key (preferred over api_key).

api_key.description: SECRET. Prefer key_env. Must not appear in committed examples.

model.description: Default model id for this provider.

models.description: Per-model overrides (timeouts, etc.) or list of model ids.

extra_headers.description: May contain credentials; omit from committed examples or use ${ENV}.

external_dirs.description: Read-only external skill roots (paths expanded for ~ and ${VAR}). Local BACKEND_HOME/skills/ still wins on name collision. Hermes accepts a single path string or a list of paths.

disabled.description: Skill ids/names/folder basenames disabled for the agent. Portal settings skill toggle (settings.patch skill.set_enabled) mutates this list. Empty = all discovered skills enabled.

creation_nudge_interval.description: Remind the agent to create skills every N tool iterations; 0 disables.

inline_shell.description: Allow !`cmd` pre-exec in skill bodies (off by default).

write_approval.description: Stage skill_manage writes for operator approval.

provider.description: Scheduler provider id. Empty = built-in in-process ticker; e.g. chronos for managed scale-to-zero.

chronos.description: NAS-mediated managed cron settings (non-secret URLs/audience). No external-scheduler credentials in config.

mirror_delivery.description: When true, cron deliveries are continuable in the origin chat/thread.

max_parallel_jobs.description: Max due jobs per tick; null/0 = unbounded.

output_retention.description: Keep N most recent per-job output files; <=0 disables pruning.

x-lanyard-secret-policy.description: Committed examples, artifact config/defaults.yaml, and monorepo fixtures must not contain secret values. Prefer key_env, ${VAR} substitution, host .env, and platform secret managers.
notes: key_env and api_key_env name environment variables and are allowed in examples.
Empty-string placeholders for secrets are still discouraged in committed files; omit the key.
Hermes stores many secrets in BACKEND_HOME/.env (out of this schema); do not fold those into defaults.yaml.
